summary_en: The Bank of Saga raised its annual dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 from 110 yen to 120 yen per share, with the interim dividend increased from 55 yen to 65 yen per share and the final dividend maintained at 55 yen per share.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Earnings Forecast and Dividend Forecast (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief:
The Bank of Saga announced an increase in its annual dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027. The company raised the interim dividend from 55 yen to 65 yen per share, while maintaining the final dividend at 55 yen per share, resulting in a total annual dividend of 120 yen per share, an increase of 10 yen from the previous forecast of 110 yen per share.

The interim dividend increase was decided based on the bank's fundamental dividend policy of maintaining a stable and secure management foundation over the long term while considering internal reserves. The company took into account recent business performance trends, which showed improvement in operational revenues driven primarily by gains on securities portfolio optimization and increased lending interest income and fee-based revenues.

The bank stated it will continue to maintain its basic policy of stable dividends while balancing dividend payments with retained earnings, in consideration of the public nature of banking operations. The full-year earnings forecast remains unchanged, as the company cited uncertainties in the economic and financial environment.
